windows.90: Over the last 90 days, visitors have raised concerns primarily about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention limited menu options, inconsistent food quality, and high prices that do not match portion sizes or taste. Service issues were noted, including long wait times and periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. While some healthy food choices were appreciated, many felt the recipes need adjustment. Overall, the average rating is moderate, with nearly half of the reviews expressing criticism focused on food and service.
